title: Compare MS2 spectra
doc: Scores each query MS2 spectrum against the reference spectra and keeps the best hits.

algorithms.title: Cosine
algorithms.doc: One-to-one peak pairs within the tolerance, highest intensity product first (cosine_from_pairs in crates/mzlab-lib/src/scores.rs).

algorithms.title: Modified cosine
algorithms.doc: Peaks may also pair at the precursor difference, for analogues that differ by one modification (modified_cosine in scores.rs).

applicability.note: Analogues and transformation products of a known parent

algorithms.title: Spectral entropy
algorithms.doc: Entropy similarity of the merged spectrum (entropy_from_pairs in scores.rs).
